name: Aleksey Vlasenko
description:
Technical deep dives on training large models on TPUs with PyTorch: TorchTPU and torchtitan, distributed training internals (FSDP, expert parallelism, Muon and FlexShard), profiling with XProf, XLA and Pallas kernels, and autoresearch - letting coding agents run the performance-optimization loop end to end.

I am a Tech Lead Manager on the PyTorch TPU team at Google. These videos are the long-form, visual companion to my blog, where every topic is also written up with code, profiles and numbers.

Blog: https://vlasenkoalexey.github.io
Autoresearch wiki: https://github.com/vlasenkoalexey/tpu_performance_autoresearch_wiki
GitHub: https://github.com/vlasenkoalexey
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/oleksiyvlasenko
X: https://x.com/AlekseyVlasenko

New videos every few weeks. Opinions are my own, not my employer's.

playlists.title: Distributed training internals (PyTorch)
playlists.description: How the pieces of a distributed PyTorch training step actually work: FSDP storage layouts, expert parallelism, optimizer resharding, Muon and FlexShard, DTensor placements, collectives and their overlap. Read from the source, with diagrams.

playlists.title: TPU auto-optimization with agents (autoresearch)
playlists.description: The autoresearch series: an autonomous loop that proposes a hypothesis, patches model code, runs on real TPUs, reads the profile and files a verdict. Companion to the blog series at https://vlasenkoalexey.github.io/tags/autoresearch/

playlists.title: PyTorch on TPU: TorchTPU and torchtitan
playlists.description: Training PyTorch models on Cloud TPUs: the TorchTPU backend, torchtitan recipes, scan over layers, graph trainers, launching on GKE, and what the profiles say.

playlists.title: Profiling and compilers: XProf, XLA, HLO
playlists.description: Reading an xprof trace, understanding HLO and fusions, XLA flags that matter, memory profiles, and the tooling (xprof-cli, perfsim overlays) used to find headroom.

playlists.title: Pallas kernels on TPU
playlists.description: Writing and tuning Pallas/Mosaic kernels for TPU: attention, GEMM, normalization, MoE kernels, block sizes, VMEM, and having agents author kernels with adversarial verification.

playlists.title: Agent tooling: wikify, xprof-mcp, skills
playlists.description: The tools that make coding agents useful for performance work: grounded codebase wikis (wikify-repo), the XProf MCP server and CLI, skills and sub-agents, process auditors.
